carrier_sentences: The quarterly infrastructure review covered scheduling changes for weekend maintenance windows across all regional deployments.
A new ticketing category was added this month to route hardware requests separately from software configuration requests.
The facilities team completed relocation of two backup servers to the secondary data center ahead of schedule.
Helpdesk response times improved slightly after the support rotation schedule was adjusted in August.
The next all-hands meeting will cover updates to the vendor contract renewal process.
A minor formatting update was applied to the internal wiki's navigation sidebar last week.
